The '''''Mercurial''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] in service to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Imperial [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Gareth Agamar]] served as the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[aerospace group commander]] for a long [[Time/Legends|period]] prior to taking over the [[481st Experimental Starfighter Testing Squadron]].<ref name="Phantoms" /> As an ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer, ''Mercurial'' had a length of 1,600 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]<ref name="DB" /> and was manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Mercurial'' was mentioned in "[[Phantoms in the Dark]]," a scenario included in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Phantoms" />
